# PR Quality Checklist Full Guide

Use this guide for final release-readiness checks.

## Scope

- Functional verification
- Test and build readiness
- Risk and rollback confidence
- Documentation and follow-up clarity

## Core Playbook

1. Confirm changed behavior and edge coverage.
2. Confirm deployment and rollback safety.
3. Capture residual risks.
4. Publish concise handoff summary.
